justification: Four typed-absence fixes on served output, three on the PAID conveyancing channel. The headline defects being removed: a crashed shadow scenario served as shadow_length_m 0.0 and fed adg_compliant true (a crash became a compliance pass); a paid PDF could assemble from an arbitrarily old cached run — and flood re-stamped stale outputs with today's date; one try-block over four DB fetches rendered mid-failure as clean absence; a failed TOD check silently deleted the PDF's TOD section (DQ-36's omission twin).

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_shadow_detector.py tests/test_typed_absence_fixes.py tests/test_conveyancing_tod.py tests/test_conveyancing_truth.py tests/test_flood_truth.py -q
falsifiable_check.passes_when: an errored scenario carries status 'unavailable' with None measurements and _adg_compliant(errored noon) is None; a mid-failure in one DB fetch leaves the other three intact and typed; an expired cache entry is a miss and a cache-copied flood row keeps its ORIGINAL run_date; build_tod_uplift_lines(None,...) renders not_assessed; the free-tier confidence caps on live_query_failures
falsifiable_check.fails_when: any of the four old behaviours returns: errored-noon → compliance pass (test_adg_compliant_errored_noon...), single-try fetch collapse (test_mid_failure_leaves_other_fetches_intact), run_date re-stamp (test_write_report_carries_original_run_date), or TOD silent omission (test_tod_lookup_failed_renders_not_assessed_never_vanishes) — each pin FAILS on the pre-change code
falsifiable_check.demonstrated_failing: Each pin was written against the observed old behaviour cited in the absence census (docs/qa/absence-semantics-census-2026-08.md rows 19/20, 15/17, 1, 7): shadow_detector.py:264-269 served 0.0m/False from an error dict and :305-308 returned True on a missing noon ('can't assess — default to compliant', its own comment); conveyancing.py:927-930 had no age filter; flood_truth.py:1745 stamped date.today() on cached outputs; generate_conveyancing_report build_tod_uplift_lines returned render=False for tod=None. Three previously-green tests encoding the old doctrine were flipped with their reasons stated in-test.
falsifiable_check.mutation_evidence: Revert _adg_compliant's None arms to True → 4 tests fail. Merge the four try-blocks back into one → the mid-failure pin fails on dcp/heritage assertions. Drop run_date from _write_report → the params[5] assertion fails. Return render False for tod None → the fix-4 pin fails on three assertions. Re-order build_shadow_row's None check after the height branches → the no-percent-claim pin fails.

pre_impl.existing_data: No DB writes. Read-path changes only: shadow scenario/verdict shaping, two cache read policies (conveyancing 24h via created_at, flood 90d via run_date — both columns verified to exist: conveyancing_cache.created_at written at :902-906, property_reports.run_date in _write_report's INSERT), one closure extracted to module level (_fetch_pdf_db_data, following the _nearby_da_count extraction precedent).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Pre-fix cached shadow rows lack the scenario 'status' key: every consumer treats absent status as computed (ShadowScenario.status optional; _adg_compliant checks == 'unavailable', so absent ≠ unavailable). Older generate_pdf callers omit db_fetch_failed → None → {} → nothing reported failed (backward compatible).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Verdict-changing only on previously-broken paths: errored/missing noon (was true, now None), failed TOD (was vanished section, now not-assessed section), expired caches (was served, now recomputed), mid-failure fetches (was clean absence, now typed). Computed paths keep identical outputs — the full pytest suite of pre-existing behaviour tests stayed green except the three old-doctrine tests deliberately flipped.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Shadow model error → typed unavailable scenario + confidence low + ADG not-assessed. Both TOD layers failing → rendered not-assessed disclosure. DB connect failure → all four PDF fetches typed failed and listed in the coverage panel.
pre_impl.frontend_type: adg_compliant widened to boolean|null in ShadowReportData (lib/pdf/shadow-report.tsx:60) and ShadowTool's outputs interface; ShadowScenario gains optional status + nullable measurement fields; generate route preserves null instead of Boolean-coercing. reports/shadow/[report_id]/page.tsx already rendered three-state ('N/A') and ShadowDetailDisplay already typed boolean|null — verified before change.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: After: a failed noon renders 'Not assessed' rows/badges (PDF risk row, shadow PDF finding, ShadowTool headline) — never 'ADG concern', never 'Meets test', never an objection paragraph. A failed TOD check renders a visible not-assessed section. A mid-failure PDF lists which checks could not be completed. An expired cache costs latency (full re-run), never correctness.

functions.name: _fetch_pdf_db_data
functions.input: db_url, coordinates, lot geometry WKT, parsed controls dict and the resolved DCP former-council slug
functions.output: (das, lep, dcp, heritage, failed) — four independent fetch results plus a per-fetch failed map consumed by generate_pdf's coverage panel and section renderers
functions.if_none: no db_url or connect failure → every applicable fetch reported failed; N/A fetches (no clause / no council) are NOT failed — three states, never two

functions.name: _adg_compliant
functions.input: the scenario list built by _build_scenario_list, each entry carrying a computed/unavailable status
functions.output: True/False verdict from a computed noon scenario, or None (not assessed) — never a verdict from absence
functions.if_none: missing noon, unavailable noon, or unknown overlap → None; every consumer renders a not-assessed state for it (verified per consumer, cited in the PR)

functions.name: build_tod_uplift_lines
functions.input: fetch_tod_catchment result or None (both layers failed), capacity engine result, strata flag
functions.output: render/not_assessed/disclosure lines for PDF section 12 — a failed check now RENDERS as not-assessed
functions.if_none: tod None → render True + not_assessed + could-not-be-completed disclosure; held_line/scope None (call site now guards) — never a vanished section

values.nullable: absent on pre-fix cached rows — treated as computed everywhere (== 'unavailable' checks only)
values.if_missing: legacy rows behave exactly as before the fix

values.nullable: yes (very old rows) — falls back to today with the fallback visible in code
values.if_missing: response carries today's date only when no original date exists to preserve

queries.purpose: flood cache read with max-age policy
queries.where_clause: product='flood' AND address=%s AND run_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
queries.if_zero: no fresh row → full recompute (the existing slow path); staleness costs latency, never correctness
queries.if_wrong: poisoned rows still filtered by _first_valid_cached_row (#762, unchanged)

queries.purpose: pipeline cache read with 24h expiry, expiry typed distinct from miss
queries.where_clause: report_id = %s with computed `expired` flag (created_at < NOW() - make_interval(hours=>24))
queries.if_zero: miss → PDF endpoint's existing full-pipeline fallback
queries.if_wrong: an expired entry logged as EXPIRED, returned as None — never served

break_it.scenario: pybdshadow raises while computing the Jun 21 noon scenario for a lot
break_it.what_happens: OLD: scenario served 0.0m/no-overlap, adg_compliant true — a crash became 'meets the ADG solar access test' on the free tool, the shadow PDF and the paid conveyancing PDF
break_it.how: typed unavailable scenario → _adg_compliant None → every consumer renders not-assessed; run confidence capped low

break_it.scenario: LEP-clause query raises mid-way through the PDF's DB fetch batch
break_it.what_happens: OLD: DCP setbacks and heritage silently emptied too; PDF rendered 'not extracted for this LGA' coverage claims about checks that never ran
break_it.how: four independent try blocks + per-fetch failed map; coverage panel lists not-completed checks; DCP else-branch says could-not-be-retrieved

break_it.scenario: PDF requested days after the free-tier run (abandoned checkout resumed)
break_it.what_happens: OLD: PDF assembled from the stale cache silently, no age bound at all
break_it.how: 24h max age; expired = logged miss → full re-run

break_it.scenario: flood re-serve of a months-old cached analysis for a repeat address lookup
break_it.what_happens: OLD: served AND re-written under a fresh report_id wearing today's run_date — a freshness lie on a hazard product
break_it.how: 90-day max age + original run_date preserved in response (cache_hit flag added) and in the copied row

break_it.scenario: both TOD catchment layers down at PDF generation
break_it.what_happens: OLD: section 12 vanished — indistinguishable from 'checked, not in a catchment' (DQ-36's silent-omission twin, on the paid channel)
break_it.how: build_tod_uplift_lines renders not_assessed with an explicit could-not-be-completed disclosure; strata suppression unchanged and tested

break_it.scenario: free-tier badge claims high confidence while its own DA check failed
break_it.what_happens: OLD: live_query_failures existed but no caller passed it — the badge ignored the report's own absence state
break_it.how: run_conveyancing passes live_query_failures=1 on da_fetch_failed → cap to medium (2+ → low)

break_it.scenario: legacy cached shadow rows (no status key) start rendering as unavailable
break_it.what_happens: historical reports would silently flip from their issued verdicts to not-assessed states
break_it.how: absent status ≠ 'unavailable' at every check site (equality, not truthiness); TS type optional
break_it.repro: pytest tests/test_shadow_detector.py (legacy-shaped fixtures carry no status and still verdict)

post_merge.db_reset: No — no schema or data changes; two cache read policies only.
post_merge.manual_verify: Optional: request a flood report for an address with an old cached row — response shows the original run_date and cache_hit true; block the shadow model and confirm the tool shows 'analysis incomplete', not a verdict.

checks.pdf_confidence_evidence: grep 'Confidence' over generate_conveyancing_report.py = 0 display hits — the paid PDF makes no confidence representation; the claim lives on the free-tier response, now wired to its own failure state
